title: The Paper Pulp in the Screen
youtube_title: The Paper Pulp in the Screen | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets a small thing finish its quiet work.
summary: At a bakery kitchen where dough and jam are left to finish, Yuri wants to check on a paper pulp settling in a small screen before it is ready. With Mama nearby, Yuri leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
